d:
A rain-curtailed contest that witnessed an absolute batting blitz!
Shehan Jayasuriya's explosive 39 off just 11 balls and Andre Russell's unbeaten 29 off 10 balls powered Biratnagar Kings to 105/2 in five overs. The Kings followed it up with a disciplined bowling performance, restricting Sudur Paschim Royals to 70/3 and securing a 35-run victory!
